# App Launch OS

> The open-source operating system for launching premium mobile apps.
> Designed for human engineers and AI coding agents (Google Antigravity, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Windsurf).

## Core Documentation
- [README.md](README.md): Master orientation and complete system manual.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): AI agent operational contract, prompt templates, and routing guide.
- [IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md](IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md): 35KB master execution blueprint.
- [awesome.md](awesome.md): 90+ verified mobile open-source libraries with licenses and tiers.

## Store Submission & Policy Checklists
- [checklists/appstore-submission.md](checklists/appstore-submission.md): Apple App Review Guideline verification (Guideline 2.1, 5.1.1, 3.1.1).
- [checklists/playstore-submission.md](checklists/playstore-submission.md): Google Play 20-tester rule, API 35, Data Safety form.
- [policies/apple-review-essentials.md](policies/apple-review-essentials.md): Deep-dive Apple App Review guidance (<90d verified).
- [policies/play-policy-essentials.md](policies/play-policy-essentials.md): Deep-dive Google Play policy guidance (<90d verified).
- [policies/privacy-compliance.md](policies/privacy-compliance.md): Apple Privacy Manifests, GDPR, CCPA, and SDK symbol matching.

## Design Engineering & Premium UX
- [decisions/007-design-system.md](decisions/007-design-system.md): 3-layer DTCG design token architecture (NativeWind v4).
- [decisions/008-motion-system.md](decisions/008-motion-system.md): 60/120 FPS Reanimated 3 UI thread motion specifications.
- [decisions/009-premium-ux.md](decisions/009-premium-ux.md): expo-haptics matrix, Moti skeletons, and frosted glass.
- [checklists/premium-ux.md](checklists/premium-ux.md): 100+ point premium mobile UX verification checklist.

## Growth, Paywalls & Research
- [findings/paywall.md](findings/paywall.md): StoreKit 2 paywall wireframe and conversion anatomy.
- [findings/aso.md](findings/aso.md): App Store Optimization keyword indexing and icon masks.
- [findings/onboarding.md](findings/onboarding.md): Mobile onboarding and permission priming psychology.
- [templates/event-taxonomy.md](templates/event-taxonomy.md): Standardized mobile analytics event tracking sheet.

## Legal & Compliance Templates
- [templates/privacy-policy.md](templates/privacy-policy.md): Store-compliant mobile privacy policy template.
- [templates/terms-of-service.md](templates/terms-of-service.md): Mobile SaaS & subscription terms of service template.
